title: Pipeline Setup Workflow
narrative_arc: Complete numbered technical workflow for a data engineer establishing a new DataStack pipeline from scratch — from making raw data accessible through to uploading a tested mapping to CKAN. Bridges the conceptual add-a-use-case guide with the detailed per-tool guides.

sections.heading: intro
sections.purpose: Audience framing — P3 data engineer/operator. Pointer to add-a-use-case.md for P1 readers.

sections.heading: Step 1 — Make your raw data file accessible
sections.purpose: HTTP accessibility requirement for pipeline services. Three cases: CKAN-deployed, public portal, dev/test.

sections.heading: Step 2 — Generate the metadata file (CSVW)
sections.purpose: CKAN auto path vs standalone CSVToCSVW UI. Link to UI and /api/docs. Pointer to csvtocsvw.md.

sections.heading: Step 3 — (Optional) Make the metadata file accessible
sections.purpose: Only needed when CKAN is not hosting the CSVW. Skip condition explicit.

sections.heading: Step 4 — Create or locate a prototype graph
sections.purpose: Reuse from PMDCO library vs author new in Ontosphere. Link to author-a-prototype-graph.md.

sections.heading: Step 5 — Make the prototype graph accessible
sections.purpose: Public URL requirement for MapToMethod/RDFConverter. Options: GitHub raw, CKAN.

sections.heading: Step 6 — Create the mapping
sections.purpose: Two options: MapToMethod UI for standard cases; YARRRML direct authoring (manual or AI) for complex. Links to UI, /api/docs, author-a-mapping.md, Matey editor.

sections.heading: Step 7 — Test the mapping
sections.purpose: checkmapping (rules_skipped == 0 gate) + api/test for triple count and per-rule stats. Link to RDFConverter UI and /api/docs.

sections.heading: Step 8 — Verify the output graph
sections.purpose: Produce joined TTL. Two verification paths: Ontosphere (OWL 2 DL reasoning + SHACL) or manual TTL inspection.

sections.heading: Step 9 — Upload the mapping to CKAN
sections.purpose: YAML upload to mappings group. Explains automatic trigger behaviour once mapping is in the group.

sections.heading: Quick reference — all service UIs and API explorers
sections.purpose: Single table: all four services with Web UI and /api/docs links.
